theory.title: Conectores narrativos: as, while, by the time y eventually
theory.explanation: Usa conectores narrativos para indicar cuándo ocurren los hechos y cómo avanza una historia. While y as introducen acciones en curso; by the time destaca que algo ya se había completado; eventually presenta el resultado final.
theory.tip: Usa conectores temporales para que tu relato tenga un orden claro.

content.passage: While Leo was travelling through Wales, he missed a connection because the first train was delayed. At first, he felt worried because he had booked a room in a small village. As he was checking the timetable, another passenger offered help. By the time the next train arrived, Leo had found a new route. Eventually, he reached the village and discovered that the hotel owner had waited for him. In the end, the unexpected delay became a good story.

items.prompt: Tell a travel story using while and eventually.
items.modelAnswer: While I was travelling along the coast, our bus broke down near a small village. We waited for another service and eventually arrived at the beach two hours late. The delay was frustrating, but we discovered a lovely café while waiting.

items.prompt: Describe what happened before you reached a destination.
items.modelAnswer: Before I reached the destination, I had already checked the hotel address and downloaded a map. I also bought a local transport ticket at the airport. Those small preparations made the final part of the journey simple.

items.prompt: Talk about a time something unexpected happened on a journey.
items.modelAnswer: On a trip to the mountains, the weather changed suddenly and the path became difficult to follow. We stopped, checked the map and chose a safer route back to the village. It was not the adventure we expected, but we learned to be careful.

items.prompt: Explain what you were doing when a plan changed.
items.modelAnswer: I was looking at the departure board when I noticed that our platform had changed. We had to collect our bags quickly and walk to another part of the station. Luckily, we arrived before the train left.

items.prompt: Use by the time to describe a memorable arrival.
items.modelAnswer: By the time we reached the seaside town, the shops were already closing. We had missed the afternoon market, but we found a small restaurant and enjoyed dinner beside the harbour. The evening turned out to be special.

items.prompt: Tell a story with a clear beginning and ending.
items.modelAnswer: My suitcase was too heavy to carry up the hotel stairs, so a member of staff offered to help. He also explained where the lift was and showed me the quickest way to my room. His kindness made me feel welcome.

items.prompt: Describe how someone helped you during a trip.
items.modelAnswer: A journey to a music festival did not go according to plan because our coach arrived at the wrong entrance. We asked a volunteer for directions and followed a marked path. We missed the first performance, but enjoyed the rest of the day.

items.prompt: Talk about a journey that did not go according to plan.
items.modelAnswer: Last winter, I travelled to visit a friend, but heavy snow delayed the train. I checked the service updates and sent my friend a message. We changed the meeting place to a café near the station.

items.prompt: Explain how you solved a travel problem.
items.modelAnswer: When my luggage did not arrive, I reported it at the airline desk and gave them my hotel address. I kept the reference number and bought a few essential items. The suitcase was delivered the following evening.

items.prompt: Retell an experience using at first, meanwhile and in the end.
items.modelAnswer: At first, I was worried because I couldn't find the bus stop. Meanwhile, my friend checked the route on her phone and found the correct street. In the end, we caught the next bus and reached the hotel safely.

content.audioTranscript: A: We are planning a trip next month. B: Where are you going? A: We are travelling to a historic town. B: Have you booked the journey? A: Yes, and we have printed the tickets. B: Which station will you use? A: The central one. B: Is there a local guide? A: Yes, we made a booking online. B: Do you know the platform? A: It is shown on the app. B: What will you visit? A: The museum and the market. B: Are you learning about local customs? A: Yes, and we are staying at a small hotel. B: Enjoy your arrival!
